findings.title: Coverage's raw count is not scoped to the selected product shape
findings.description: `raw_counts` receives only `(session_date, open_ns, close_ns)` triples and counts every `tick_trade` row in those intervals, with no join to `tick_archive_unit`/`tick_request` and no shape parameters. By contrast, `ledger_totals` at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/status_reads.py:96-107` uses `_SHAPE_WHERE` from `src/manta_trading/data/tick/status_reads.py:55-59` to filter by dataset, symbols, `stype_in`, stored tiers, and the current-unit predicate. `build_coverage` therefore compares a shape-filtered ledger at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/tick_coverage.py:108-109` against unfiltered raw rows at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/tick_coverage.py:110-112`. The current ES-only universe and tests mask this, but a second universe product will make `coverage --product` count other products' rows that fall in the same session windows; `_session_row` in `src/manta_trading/data/tick/tick_coverage.py:72-86` then reports those instruments as ledger `0`, raw `>0` mismatches, causing a false exit 3. Filter raw rows by current units of the same shape, or carry product/shape identity into the raw table.

findings.title: The new raw-count scan has no statement timeout or backend cancellation
findings.description: `coverage --start --end` has no maximum range beyond the required dates in `src/manta_trading/cli/commands/tick_store_cmds.py:205-237`; `build_coverage` passes every session in the requested range to `raw_counts` at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/tick_coverage.py:106-112`. The SQL at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/status_reads.py:164-171` scans `tick_trade` over `min(opens)..max(closes)` and joins to arrays, but neither `_read` at `src/manta_trading/cli/commands/tick_store_cmds.py:156-168` nor `_connect` at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/store_context.py:157-167` sets `statement_timeout`, and there is no `pg_cancel_backend` path for a client-side timeout/interrupt. The SQL rules require a statement timeout for long-running queries and server-side cancellation after a client timeout; without it, a wide coverage range can tie up a backend after the CLI has gone away. Add an explicit bounded `SET LOCAL statement_timeout` and cancellation envelope for this read path.

findings.title: Status/coverage DB read paths have no load-test bound or gate
findings.description: The only slice-225 load test is `test/load/test_225_tick_ingest_nfr.py:1-15`, whose docstring and assertions cover ingest unit time and event-loop gap. The new status/coverage path adds the raw-count proof at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/tick_coverage.py:99-115` and the `tick_trade` scan at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/status_reads.py:154-174`, both on the DB/network path, but `test/load/` has no status/coverage load module and no latency, throughput, or resource bound for a realistic range. The Python rules require a load test and CI gate for slices touching network/environment-layer paths; integration tests such as `test/integration/data/test_tick_status_cli.py:99-115` assert functional JSON shape only. Add a load test that runs `build_coverage`/`coverage` over a representative range and asserts a latency or resource ceiling.

findings.title: Calendar-horizon refusals are reported as storage outages
findings.description: `calendar_sessions` catches `OutOfPopulatedRangeError` at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/tick_status_build.py:73-74` and re-raises it as `TickCalendarError`. `exit_code_for` maps every `TickCalendarError` to `EXIT_STORAGE` at `src/manta_trading/cli/commands/tick_exit.py:55-58`, while `READ_EPILOG` at `src/manta_trading/cli/commands/tick_store_cmds.py:37-43` reserves exit 4 for an unreachable tick/calendar database and exit 1 for preflight/input problems. Thus a valid `--start/--end` that lies outside the populated calendar horizon, reached via `src/manta_trading/data/tick/tick_coverage.py:99-104`, exits 4 as if production storage were down instead of a preflight refusal naming the horizon. Keep `TickCalendarError` for actual calendar outages, but classify `OutOfPopulatedRangeError` as preflight for these read verbs and add a regression test.

findings.title: New SQL reads do not follow the project SQL style rules
findings.description: The new SQL module defines single-letter aliases `u`, `r`, and `l` in `_UNITS`, `_LEDGER_UNITS`, and `_SHAPE_WHERE` at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/status_reads.py:50-59`, then reuses `h`, `d`, `t`, and `s` throughout queries at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/status_reads.py:81-151` and `src/manta_trading/data/tick/status_reads.py:154-174`. SELECT lists are compressed inline rather than one column per line with leading commas. The SQL rules require meaningful aliases and the prescribed SELECT layout. Use descriptive aliases such as `archive_unit`, `ingest_ledger`, `held`, `definition`, `trade`, and `session`, and format the SELECT lists consistently.

findings.title: CLI documentation and public API docstrings drift from the new renderer structure
findings.description: The top-level `tick.py` docstring at `src/manta_trading/cli/commands/tick.py:1-10` still says Rich rendering lives in `tick_render.py` and `tick_pass_render.py`, but status/coverage rendering is now in `src/manta_trading/cli/commands/tick_status_render.py:1-7` and ingest rendering is imported separately in `src/manta_trading/cli/commands/tick_store_cmds.py` around the ingest command body. Public functions such as `print_status`, `coverage_to_dict`, and `print_coverage` in `src/manta_trading/cli/commands/tick_status_render.py:114-161` also have no docstrings, while the Python rules require docstrings for public APIs. Update the module documentation and add concise Google/NumPy-style docstrings for the new public rendering helpers.
